landing.hero_title: Every cow, every litre — one calm place to run your dairy.
landing.hero_subtitle: Spring Water Dairy keeps your herd registry, milk sessions, breeding, health and reports together — on the farm, offline or online.
landing.why_title: Everything your herd needs, in one place
landing.why_subtitle: From the first ear tag to the final PDF report, daily farm work stays simple, accurate and shared with the right people.
landing.feature_herd_body: Keep ear tags, breeds, pens, categories and animal history in one searchable herd book.
landing.feature_milk_body: Record morning, midday and evening milking in seconds and see per-cow and farm-wide yield.
landing.feature_breeding_body: Track heats, services, pregnancy checks and expected calvings with timely reminders.
landing.feature_health_body: Log treatments and vaccinations, with milk and meat withholding dates always visible.
landing.feature_reports_body: Generate herd, milk, breeding and health reports, then download them as printable PDFs.
landing.feature_multifarm_body: Manage several farms from one account and give every teammate only the access they need.
landing.how_subtitle: No spreadsheets to reconcile. Set up once, then let the daily routine take a few minutes.
landing.how_step1_body: Add your farm name, currency and units in a short setup wizard.
landing.how_step2_body: Enter animals with ear tags, breeds and pens — or import them later.
landing.how_step3_body: Capture milk sessions, health treatments, heats and calvings as they happen.
landing.how_step4_body: Check dashboards, respond to alert rules and export reports for buyers or vets.
landing.plans_subtitle: Start free, then grow when you need more animals, users and records. No surprise add-ons.
landing.plans_load_error: We couldn't load the plans right now. Check your connection and try again.
landing.plans_empty: No plans are available yet. Please check back soon.
landing.faq_a1: Yes. Starter is free and includes up to 50 animals, 3 users, 3,000 milk records a month and 5 alert rules.
landing.faq_a2: Yes. Add a farm for each herd or location and switch between them from one account. Access is controlled by roles on each farm.
landing.faq_a3: Yes. Records are saved on your device when the network drops and sync automatically when you're back online.
landing.faq_a4: Create an account, create your first farm, add your herd and start recording a milk session. You can compare plans any time before you commit.
landing.final_title: Ready to bring order to the dairy?
landing.final_subtitle: Start with the free plan, invite your team and see your herd clearly from day one.
